cards.name: Playful Shove
cards.oracle_text:
Playful Shove deals 1 damage to any target.
Draw a card.

rulings.comment: If the target is illegal as Playful Shove tries to resolve, it won’t resolve and none of its effects will happen. You won’t draw a card.
